newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Arco seeks partners for Manila oil venture.
newsitem.headline: Arco seeks partners for Manila oil venture.

text.p: Arco Philippines Inc, a unit of U.S-based Atlantic Richfield Co, is looking for partners to drill the Sulu Sea in southern Philippines.
Philippine National Oil Co-Exploration Corp president Rufino Bomasang told Reuters in an interview that the national oil co was approached by Arco for a possible farm-in in the Sulu Sea consortium.
"The talks are still in the preliminary stages. We are studying the possibility of taking in some interest," Bomasang said.

Arco Philippines was granted by the energy department a geophysical survey and exploration contract covering the Sulu Sea allowing the firm to drill two wells in an area believed to be gas-prone. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 fax 8176267
